title: The design state is the state reading; the overview and classifying decisions go
situation: The design-state story makes the design state the one reading a session reconstitutes from and decisions realization only. The journal offers an overview told as prose, a state reading carrying standing decisions, a legend and history on request, a decide that takes a kind, a classify verb, and a leakage reading that inspects decisions.
decision: (1) Two tasks, each one builder: the journal capability and its tests and references; the delivered text and the harness's session-start note. One branch carries the design and its realization to dev; review is Ask with the operator as its one reviewer. (2) The state reading answers only the purpose, the delivered practice apart and, per context, its subject, relation, competing descriptions when any, live concepts each one line 'name ≜ wording', and competing versions each as such a line; no legend, no decisions, no built-from parts, no reasons and no history flag. (3) The overview verb and its prose account are deleted. (4) The design reading stays as each context's concepts with the parts each is built from, and with history its retired concepts and reasons. (5) The effort recorded for past work is read with a context's own history. (6) decide records realization only, taking no kind and marking every new decision realization; classify is deleted; leakage inspects concept wordings, context descriptions and examples, never decisions, and takes no history flag. (7) Standing decisions are read with the decisions reading alone.
consequences: Every reading's explanation, the command's reference and the tests that read the overview change with it; entries already recorded, kinds and classifications included, are still read as recorded, in history.
